%% Geometry deck: side footnotes in revealed content (v10.12.0). A footnote after a \pause and one with a
%% specification of its own appear in the strip from step 2; until v10.12.0 the strip showed both on every step.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\sidefootnotes
\begin{standardframe}{Side footnotes, revealed}
	\begin{itemize}
		\item Shown at once\footnote{Sidealways: on every step.}
		\item With a specification of its own\footnote<2->{Sideown: from step 2.}
		\pause
		\item After a pause\footnote{Sidepause: with the item, from step 2.}
	\end{itemize}
\end{standardframe}
